title: On the Bank Crisis — FDR's First Fireside Chat (1933) | Fireside
description:
Eight days into his presidency, with the nation's banks closed for a week, Roosevelt sat before a microphone on a Sunday evening and explained the banking system in plain language. Some sixty million people listened. The first fireside chat.

Fireside — the talks America heard on the radio, spoken again. Every episode stays true to the facts: the radio sets the scene, then speaks the real words verbatim. New episodes daily. #FiresideRadio
